verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for a spend-management SaaS, but the evidence shows no user-definable scheduled or recurring jobs or workflows. The closest items are adjacent features that do not count: card limits that reset daily, weekly, or monthly; card auto-deletion on an end date; and time or day-of-week spending restrictions. Webhooks and automated expense reporting are event-driven or marketing claims, not a scheduling capability.
